pothole.description: A pothole is a damaged portion of a road surface that can create safety risks for vehicles and pedestrians.
pothole.recommended_action: Report the pothole with a clear image and accurate location so the responsible road department can inspect and repair it.

road_damage.description: Road damage may include cracks, broken surfaces, uneven pavement, or other defects affecting road safety.
road_damage.recommended_action: Submit a complaint with an image and location so the road maintenance team can inspect the damaged area.

damaged_streetlight.description: A damaged or non-functional streetlight can reduce visibility and create safety concerns, particularly at night.
damaged_streetlight.recommended_action: Report the streetlight with its location and an image so the electrical or municipal maintenance team can inspect it.

water_leakage.description: Visible water leakage can waste water and may damage roads, buildings, or surrounding infrastructure.
water_leakage.recommended_action: Report the leakage with its exact location and an image so the water department can investigate and repair it.
water_leakage.department: Water Supply and Municipal Engineering Department

garbage.description: Accumulated or improperly disposed garbage can create health risks, unpleasant surroundings, blocked drainage, and environmental problems.
garbage.recommended_action: Report the garbage accumulation with a clear image and accurate location so the municipal waste-management team can inspect and arrange collection or cleanup.
